package loomoji // import "ubunatic.com/loom/examples/loomoji/loomoji"

Package loomoji is experimental; its API may change between releases. See
docs/APIStability.md for the package stability policy.

Package loomoji demonstrates a compact inline emoji and symbol picker.

CONSTANTS

const (
	RenderModeDefault   = "default"
	RenderModePad1      = "pad-1"
	RenderModeNoVS16    = "no-vs16"
	RenderModeNoVS16Pad = "no-vs16-pad"
	RenderModeForceVS16 = "force-vs16"
	RenderModeSplitZWJ  = "split-zwj"
	RenderModeBaseOnly  = "base-only"
)
    Render mode identifiers


FUNCTIONS

func ApplyRenderMode(glyph, mode string) string
    ApplyRenderMode transforms a glyph string according to the requested mode.

func AvailableRenderModes(glyph string) []string
    AvailableRenderModes returns the rendering modes applicable to a glyph.

func EvaluateVTEMode(glyph string) string
    EvaluateVTEMode returns the recommended rendering mode for a glyph in VTE
    terminals from spec.

func EvaluateVTEWidth(glyph string) int
    EvaluateVTEWidth predicts/evaluates the cell width expected for a glyph in
    VTE-based terminals.

func FormatEmojiGrid(glyphs []string, width int, cols int) string
    FormatEmojiGrid renders a single width section grid using the active render
    path.

func FormatEmojiGridWithPath(glyphs []string, width int, cols int, path measure.RenderPath) string
    FormatEmojiGridWithPath renders a single width section grid for a specific
    render path.

func NewWidget(args []string) (loom.Widget, error)
    NewWidget constructs the picker widget for embedding in another Loom app.

func RenderEmojiGrid(allGlyphs []string, widthFilter string) (string, error)
    RenderEmojiGrid renders a formatted ascii grid of emojis grouped by visual
    width using the active render path.

func RenderEmojiGridWithPath(allGlyphs []string, widthFilter string, path measure.RenderPath) (string, error)
    RenderEmojiGridWithPath renders a formatted ascii grid of emojis grouped by
    visual width for a specific render path.

func Run(args []string) error
    Run launches the interactive emoji and symbol picker.


TYPES

type MeasureFilter string
    MeasureFilter selects one category of recorded measurements for review.

const (
	MeasureFilterAll             MeasureFilter = "all"
	MeasureFilterUnassessed      MeasureFilter = "unassessed"
	MeasureFilterWidth1          MeasureFilter = "width-1"
	MeasureFilterWidth2          MeasureFilter = "width-2"
	MeasureFilterWidth3          MeasureFilter = "width-3"
	MeasureFilterWidth4          MeasureFilter = "width-4"
	MeasureFilterUnsure          MeasureFilter = "unsure"
	MeasureFilterDiffersFromLoom MeasureFilter = "differs-from-loom"
	MeasureFilterHasComment      MeasureFilter = "has-comment"
)
type MeasureOptions struct {
	Review          bool
	Filter          MeasureFilter
	DiffersFromLoom bool
	HasComment      bool
}
    MeasureOptions selects either the normal unmeasured flow or recorded-glyph
    review.

type MeasureWidget struct {
	// Has unexported fields.
}
    MeasureWidget guides a user through recording terminal-rendered glyph
    widths.

func NewMeasureWidget(store *MeasurementStore, jsonPath, textPath string) *MeasureWidget
    NewMeasureWidget creates a keyboard-driven measure widget for unrecorded
    loomoji glyphs.

func NewMeasureWidgetWithOptions(store *MeasurementStore, jsonPath, textPath string, options MeasureOptions) *MeasureWidget
    NewMeasureWidgetWithOptions creates a measurement widget with optional
    review filters.

func (w *MeasureWidget) ConsumeKey(e loom.KeyEvent) loom.EventResult
    ConsumeKey processes page answers, comments, confirmation, and navigation.

func (*MeasureWidget) ConsumeMouse(loom.MouseEvent) loom.EventResult
    ConsumeMouse implements the loom.Widget interface; the measure flow is
    keyboard-only.

func (w *MeasureWidget) CurrentGlyph() string
    CurrentGlyph returns the selected glyph on the current page, or an empty
    string when complete.

func (w *MeasureWidget) Draw(c *loom.Canvas, r loom.Rect)
    Draw renders the current page as a numbered glyph measurement table.

func (w *MeasureWidget) Err() error
    Err reports the most recent page save failure, if any.

func (w *MeasureWidget) PageGlyphs() []string
    PageGlyphs returns up to twenty unmeasured glyphs in the current page.

func (w *MeasureWidget) PageMeasurement(row int) Measurement
    PageMeasurement returns a row's staged measurement, seeded with Loom's
    computed width.

func (w *MeasureWidget) Remaining() int
    Remaining returns the number of glyphs on the current and following pages.

type Measurement struct {
	Glyph         string   `json:"glyph"`
	Codepoints    []string `json:"codepoints"`
	ComputedWidth int      `json:"computed_width"`
	VTEWidth      int      `json:"vte_width,omitempty"`
	MeasuredWidth int      `json:"measured_width"`
	RenderMode    string   `json:"render_mode,omitempty"`
	Answered      bool     `json:"answered,omitempty"`
	Comment       string   `json:"comment,omitempty"`
}
    Measurement contains the observed and computed width of one glyph.
    MeasuredWidth is 1 through 4 for a confirmed result and 0 for unsure/other.

func NewMeasurement(glyph string) Measurement
    NewMeasurement creates an unanswered record using Loom's current width
    policy and VTE evaluation.

type MeasurementStore struct {
	Profile TerminalProfile        `json:"terminal"`
	Entries map[string]Measurement `json:"measurements"`
}
    MeasurementStore holds observed widths for one terminal profile.

func LoadMeasurementStore(path string) (*MeasurementStore, error)
    LoadMeasurementStore reads a profile store from JSON.

func NewMeasurementStore(profile TerminalProfile) *MeasurementStore
    NewMeasurementStore creates an empty store for a terminal profile.

func (s *MeasurementStore) Filter(glyphs []string, filter MeasureFilter) []string
    Filter returns glyphs matching filter, preserving input order.

func (s *MeasurementStore) Merge(measurements ...Measurement)
    Merge adds measurements that are not already recorded, preserving prior
    answers.

func (s *MeasurementStore) Review(glyphs []string, filter MeasureFilter) []string
    Review returns recorded glyphs matching filter, preserving input order.

func (s *MeasurementStore) Save(path string) error
    Save writes the store as indented JSON, replacing the target atomically.

func (s *MeasurementStore) SaveTextReport(path string) error
    SaveTextReport writes a stable, human-readable report for the store.

func (s *MeasurementStore) Set(measurement Measurement)
    Set stores a measurement, replacing any previous record for its glyph.

func (s *MeasurementStore) Unmeasured(glyphs []string) []string
    Unmeasured returns glyphs without a saved result, preserving input order.

type TerminalProfile struct {
	Term        string `json:"term"`
	TermProgram string `json:"term_program,omitempty"`
	VTEVersion  string `json:"vte_version,omitempty"`
}
    TerminalProfile identifies the terminal whose rendered widths were recorded.

func (p TerminalProfile) Paths(dir string) (jsonPath, textPath string)
    Paths returns the JSON and text report paths for a terminal profile.
